verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֙ לֵ֣ךְ עֲלֵ֣ה מִזֶּ֔ה אַתָּ֣ה וְהָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶֽעֱלִ֖יתָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֶל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֠שְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֨ם לְיִצְחָ֤ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹב֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אֶתְּנֶֽנָּה׃ לְזַרְעֲךָ֖
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lêḵ ‘ă·lêh miz·zeh ’at·tāh wə·hā·‘ām ’ă·šer he·‘ĕ·lî·ṯā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tî lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ lê·mōr ’et·tə·nen·nāh lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Leave this place you and the people - you brought up out of the land of Egypt [and go] to the land that I promised to Abraham Isaac and Jacob when I said I will give it to your descendants

verses.original: וְשָׁלַחְתִּ֥י מַלְאָ֑ךְ לְפָנֶ֖יךָ וְגֵֽרַשְׁתִּ֗י אֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י וְהַֽחִתִּי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·laḥ·tî mal·’āḵ lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·ḡê·raš·tî ’eṯ- hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·ha·ḥit·tî wə·hap·pə·riz·zî ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî
verses.literal: And I will send an angel before you and I will drive out - the Canaanites Amorites Hittites Perizzites Hivites and Jebusites

verses.original: אֶל־ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אֶֽעֱלֶ֜ה בְּקִרְבְּךָ֗ כִּ֤י אַ֔תָּה קְשֵׁה־ עֹ֙רֶף֙ עַם־ פֶּן־ אֲכֶלְךָ֖ בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’el- ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇāš kî lō ’e·‘ĕ·leh bə·qir·bə·ḵā kî ’at·tāh qə·šêh- ‘ō·rep̄ ‘am- pen- ’ă·ḵel·ḵā bad·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey But I will not go with you because you are a stiff-necked . . . people otherwise I might destroy you on the way

verses.original: הָעָ֗ם אֶת־ וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַזֶּ֖ה הָרָ֛ע הַדָּבָ֥ר וַיִּתְאַבָּ֑לוּ וְלֹא־ אִ֥ישׁ שָׁ֛תוּ עֶדְי֖וֹ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ām ’eṯ- way·yiš·ma‘ haz·zeh hā·rā‘ had·dā·ḇār way·yiṯ·’ab·bā·lū wə·lō- ’îš šā·ṯū ‘eḏ·yōw ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: When the people - heard this bad news they went into mourning and no one put on any of his jewelry . . .

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֱמֹ֤ר אֶל־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אַתֶּ֣ם קְשֵׁה־ עֹ֔רֶף עַם־ אֶֽעֱלֶ֥ה בְקִרְבְּךָ֖ אֶחָ֛ד רֶ֧גַע וְכִלִּיתִ֑יךָ וְעַתָּ֗ה הוֹרֵ֤ד עֶדְיְךָ֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וְאֵדְעָ֖ה מָ֥ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh ’ĕ·mōr ’el- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’at·tem qə·šêh- ‘ō·rep̄ ‘am- ’e·‘ĕ·leh ḇə·qir·bə·ḵā ’e·ḥāḏ re·ḡa‘ wə·ḵil·lî·ṯî·ḵā wə·‘at·tāh hō·w·rêḏ ‘eḏ·yə·ḵā mê·‘ā·le·ḵā wə·’ê·ḏə·‘āh māh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lāḵ
verses.literal: For the LORD had said to Moses Tell . . . the Israelites . . . You are a stiff-necked . . . people If I should go with you for a single moment I would destroy you Now take off your jewelry . . . and I will decide what to do with you

verses.original: בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ וַיִּֽתְנַצְּל֧וּ עֶדְיָ֖ם מֵהַ֥ר חוֹרֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- way·yiṯ·naṣ·ṣə·lū ‘eḏ·yām mê·har ḥō·w·rêḇ
verses.literal: So the Israelites . . . - stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb [onward]

verses.original: וּמֹשֶׁה֩ יִקַּ֨ח אֶת־ הָאֹ֜הֶל וְנָֽטָה־ ל֣וֹ׀ מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֗ה הַרְחֵק֙ מִן־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְקָ֥רָא ל֖וֹ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהָיָה֙ כָּל־ מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה יֵצֵא֙ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·šeh yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- hā·’ō·hel wə·nā·ṭāh- lōw mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh har·ḥêq min- ham·ma·ḥă·neh wə·qā·rā lōw ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·hā·yāh kāl- mə·ḇaq·qêš Yah·weh yê·ṣê ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ’ă·šer mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: Now Moses used to take - the tent and pitch it . . . . . . at a distance outside the camp He called it the Tent of Meeting and anyone inquiring of the LORD would go to the Tent of Meeting - outside the camp

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה מֹשֶׁה֙ כְּצֵ֤את אֶל־ הָאֹ֔הֶל כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם וְנִ֨צְּב֔וּ יָק֙וּמוּ֙ אִ֖ישׁ פֶּ֣תַח אָהֳל֑וֹ וְהִבִּ֙יטוּ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַד־ בֹּא֖וֹ הָאֹֽהֱלָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh mō·šeh kə·ṣêṯ ’el- hā·’ō·hel kāl- hā·‘ām wə·niṣ·ṣə·ḇū yā·qū·mū ’îš pe·ṯaḥ ’ā·ho·lōw wə·hib·bî·ṭū ’a·ḥă·rê mō·šeh ‘aḏ- bō·’ōw hā·’ō·hĕ·lāh
verses.literal: Then whenever Moses went out to the tent all the people . . . would stand - at the entrances to their [own] tents and watch . . . Moses until he entered the tent

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה מֹשֶׁה֙ כְּבֹ֤א הָאֹ֔הֱלָה עַמּ֣וּד הֶֽעָנָ֔ן יֵרֵד֙ וְעָמַ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֑הֶל וְדִבֶּ֖ר עִם־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh mō·šeh kə·ḇō hā·’ō·hĕ·lāh ‘am·mūḏ he·‘ā·nān yê·rêḏ wə·‘ā·maḏ pe·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel wə·ḏib·ber ‘im- mō·šeh
verses.literal: As Moses entered the tent the pillar of cloud would come down and remain at the entrance - and the LORD would speak with Moses

verses.original: כָל־ הָעָם֙ אֶת־ וְרָאָ֤ה עַמּ֣וּד הֶֽעָנָ֔ן עֹמֵ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֑הֶל כָּל־ הָעָם֙ וְקָ֤ם וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ פֶּ֥תַח אָהֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ḵāl hā·‘ām ’eṯ- wə·rā·’āh ‘am·mūḏ he·‘ā·nān ‘ō·mêḏ pe·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel kāl- hā·‘ām wə·qām wə·hiš·ta·ḥăw·wū ’îš pe·ṯaḥ ’ā·ho·lōw
verses.literal: When all the people - saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent they . . . would stand up and worship each one at the entrance to his [own] tent

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה וְדִבֶּ֨ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֙ פָּנִ֣ים אֶל־ פָּנִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר אִ֖ישׁ יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְשָׁב֙ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה נַ֔עַר וּמְשָׁ֨רְת֜וֹ יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן־ נוּן֙ לֹ֥א יָמִ֖ישׁ מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֹֽהֶל׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh wə·ḏib·ber ’el- mō·šeh pā·nîm ’el- pā·nîm ka·’ă·šer ’îš yə·ḏab·bêr ’el- rê·‘ê·hū wə·šāḇ ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh na·‘ar ū·mə·šā·rə·ṯōw yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn lō yā·mîš mit·tō·wḵ hā·’ō·hel
verses.literal: Thus the LORD would speak to Moses face to face as a man speaks to his friend Then Moses would return to the camp but his young assistant Joshua son of Nun would not leave vvv the tent

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ יְהוָ֗ה רְ֠אֵה אַתָּ֞ה אֹמֵ֤ר אֵלַי֙ הַ֚עַל הַזֶּ֔ה הָעָ֣ם אֶת־ וְאַתָּה֙ לֹ֣א הֽוֹדַעְתַּ֔נִי אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ תִּשְׁלַ֖ח עִמִּ֑י וְאַתָּ֤ה אָמַ֙רְתָּ֙ יְדַעְתִּ֣יךָֽ בְשֵׁ֔ם וְגַם־ מָצָ֥אתָ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yō·mer ’el- Yah·weh rə·’êh ’at·tāh ’ō·mêr ’ê·lay ha·‘al haz·zeh hā·‘ām ’eṯ- wə·’at·tāh lō hō·w·ḏa‘·ta·nî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- tiš·laḥ ‘im·mî wə·’at·tāh ’ā·mar·tā yə·ḏa‘·tî·ḵā ḇə·šêm wə·ḡam- mā·ṣā·ṯā ḥên bə·‘ê·nāy
verses.literal: Then Moses said to the LORD Look You have been telling me . . . Lead this people up - but You have not let me know - whom You will send with me Yet You have said I know you by name and you have found favor in My sight

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה אִם־ נָא֩ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֜ן בְּעֵינֶ֗יךָ נָא֙ הוֹדִעֵ֤נִי אֶת־ דְּרָכֶ֔ךָ וְאֵדָ֣עֲךָ֔ לְמַ֥עַן אֶמְצָא־ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ וּרְאֵ֕ה כִּ֥י הַזֶּֽה׃ הַגּ֥וֹי עַמְּךָ֖
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’im- nā mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā nā hō·w·ḏi·‘ê·nî ’eṯ- də·rā·ḵe·ḵā wə·’ê·ḏā·‘ă·ḵā lə·ma·‘an ’em·ṣā- ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ū·rə·’êh kî haz·zeh hag·gō·w ‘am·mə·ḵā
verses.literal: Now if indeed I have found favor in Your sight please let me know - Your ways that I may know You . . . and find favor in Your sight Remember that this nation is Your people

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר פָּנַ֥י יֵלֵ֖כוּ וַהֲנִחֹ֥תִי לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar pā·nay yê·lê·ḵū wa·hă·ni·ḥō·ṯî lāḵ
verses.literal: And [the LORD] answered My Presence will go [with you] and I will give you rest

verses.original: אִם־ פָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ אֵ֤ין הֹלְכִ֔ים וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑יו אַֽל־ תַּעֲלֵ֖נוּ מִזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- pā·ne·ḵā ’ên hō·lə·ḵîm way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’al- ta·‘ă·lê·nū miz·zeh
verses.literal: If Your Presence does not go [with us] Moses replied do not lead us up from here

verses.original: וּבַמֶּ֣ה׀ יִוָּדַ֣ע אֵפ֗וֹא כִּֽי־ וְעַמֶּ֔ךָ אֲנִ֣י מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּעֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ הֲל֖וֹא בְּלֶכְתְּךָ֣ עִמָּ֑נוּ אֲנִ֣י וְעַמְּךָ֔ וְנִפְלֵ֙ינוּ֙ מִכָּ֨ל־ הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇam·meh yiw·wā·ḏa‘ ’ê·p̄ō·w kî- wə·‘am·me·ḵā ’ă·nî mā·ṣā·ṯî ḥên bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā hă·lō·w bə·leḵ·tə·ḵā ‘im·mā·nū ’ă·nî wə·‘am·mə·ḵā wə·nip̄·lē·nū mik·kāl hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: For how then can it be known . . . that Your people and I have found favor in Your sight unless You go with us [How else will] we . . . be distinguished from all the other people - on the face of the earth

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֑ה הַזֶּ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גַּ֣ם אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ כִּֽי־ מָצָ֤אתָ חֵן֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י וָאֵדָעֲךָ֖ בְּשֵֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh haz·zeh ’ă·šer gam ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār dib·bar·tā kî- mā·ṣā·ṯā ḥên bə·‘ê·nay wā·’ê·ḏā·‘ă·ḵā bə·šêm
verses.literal: So the LORD said to Moses I will do this - very - thing you have asked for you have found favor in My sight and I know you by name

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר נָ֖א אֶת־ הַרְאֵ֥נִי כְּבֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar nā ’eṯ- har·’ê·nî kə·ḇō·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: Then Moses said Please - show me Your glory

verses.original: אֲנִ֨י כָּל־ טוּבִי֙ אַעֲבִ֤יר עַל־ פָּנֶ֔יךָ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר וְקָרָ֧אתִֽי בְשֵׁ֛ם יְהוָ֖ה לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וְחַנֹּתִי֙ אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָחֹ֔ן וְרִחַמְתִּ֖י אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲרַחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî kāl- ṭū·ḇî ’a·‘ă·ḇîr ‘al- pā·ne·ḵā way·yō·mer wə·qā·rā·ṯî ḇə·šêm Yah·weh lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·ḥan·nō·ṯî ’eṯ- ’ă·šer ’ā·ḥōn wə·ri·ḥam·tî ’eṯ- ’ă·šer ’ă·ra·ḥêm
verses.literal: I will cause all My goodness to pass before you [the LORD] replied and I will proclaim [My] name the LORD in your presence I will have mercy - on whom I have mercy and I will have compassion - on whom I have compassion

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֹ֥א תוּכַ֖ל לִרְאֹ֣ת אֶת־ פָּנָ֑י כִּ֛י לֹֽא־ הָאָדָ֖ם יִרְאַ֥נִי וָחָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lō ṯū·ḵal lir·’ōṯ ’eṯ- pā·nāy kî lō- hā·’ā·ḏām yir·’a·nî wā·ḥāy
verses.literal: But He added You cannot . . . see - My face for no one can see [Me] and live

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הִנֵּ֥ה מָק֖וֹם אִתִּ֑י וְנִצַּבְתָּ֖ עַל־ הַצּֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer hin·nêh mā·qō·wm ’it·tî wə·niṣ·ṣaḇ·tā ‘al- haṣ·ṣūr
verses.literal: The LORD continued There is a place near Me where you are to stand upon a rock

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כְּבֹדִ֔י בַּעֲבֹ֣ר וְשַׂמְתִּ֖יךָ בְּנִקְרַ֣ת הַצּ֑וּר וְשַׂכֹּתִ֥י כַפִּ֛י עָלֶ֖יךָ עַד־ עָבְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kə·ḇō·ḏî ba·‘ă·ḇōr wə·śam·tî·ḵā bə·niq·raṯ haṣ·ṣūr wə·śak·kō·ṯî ḵap·pî ‘ā·le·ḵā ‘aḏ- ‘ā·ḇə·rî
verses.literal: and when My glory passes by I will put you in a cleft of the rock and cover you with My hand . . . until I have passed by

verses.original: כַּפִּ֔י וַהֲסִרֹתִי֙ אֶת־ וְרָאִ֖יתָ אֶת־ אֲחֹרָ֑י וּפָנַ֖י לֹ֥א יֵרָאֽוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kap·pî wa·hă·si·rō·ṯî ’eṯ- wə·rā·’î·ṯā ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥō·rāy ū·p̄ā·nay lō yê·rā·’ū
verses.literal: Then I will take My hand away - and you will see - My back but My face must not be seen
